T9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The Hi-C is a population average over millions of K562 nuclei. A contact value is a
frequency across cells, not a statement that these two loci touch in any one of them.
Contact is measured at 5 kb, and the median element here is 500 bp, so several
elements share a bin and cannot be told apart by this map at all.
Rao's K562 Hi-C and the CRISPR benchmark are the same cell line but different
laboratories and different cultures, and K562 is aneuploid with rearrangements that
a reference-genome contact map represents imperfectly.
Contact does not establish causation. An element and a promoter can share a domain
and a loop and still not regulate one another.
